body:
复刻 Dennis Snellenberg 首页的作品悬停预览：保留四行列表，FABRIC™ 为第三项，沿用原站字体与对应缩略图。

指针进入作品行，方形预览展开，中央出现蓝色 View 圆钮。图片、圆钮、文字分别以 1/12、1/7、1/6 的逐帧位置插值跟随指针。

预览 fixed 定位，不拦截点击。保持 1:1，宽度 clamp(10em,27.5vw,25em)，偏移 translate(-50%,-52%)。四图纵向排列，切到第三项时整条图像带上移自身高度的 50%，过渡 0.6s，Power2.easeInOut。

展开、收起均为 0.4s；曲线分别为 cubic-bezier(0.34,1,0.64,1) 与 cubic-bezier(0.36,0,0.66,0)。离开后收回预览，文字复位。

触屏使用静态可点击作品，保留键盘访问。用相同的 1080×1440 视口，对照进入、跟随、切换和离开。

variants.label: Microsoft-inspired
variants.direction: ART DIRECTION 01 — Microsoft / Metro inspired editorial typography, not Windows tiles. Bright pure white paper-flat canvas. Black Segoe-like clean typography, rich Microsoft blue #0067B8 used only for the short oversized headline and one tiny issue number. Ultra disciplined left alignment: all contents share an x-position about 8% in from the left edge. Header around upper 20%, body flowing as five naturally separated paragraphs from 27% to 88%, brand/source balanced along bottom. The English headline is "Hover\n& follow." in elegant large lightweight sans-serif, asymmetrically left aligned, with lots of confident air to its right. Small top-right issue label "02 / INTERACTIONS". Body starts under small label "REBUILD PROMPT". Do not put a frame or fill behind the body. No other text. Keep the technological feeling derived from typography, sober blue and spacing.
variants.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Create ONE finished, flat, beautifully typeset portrait prompt poster for a sophisticated design publication. Exact aspect ratio 3:4, preferably 1536x2048 or equivalent. This is a final graphic, not a photograph or mockup; fill the canvas, no surrounding objects or backdrop.
It is page two of a website interaction teardown, presenting a directly useful Chinese implementation prompt for the FABRIC hover interaction at dennissnellenberg.com. An editorial designer should have intentionally typeset this page. Modern, restrained, technologically precise, outstanding typography and optical alignment. Do not imitate generic AI startup graphics.
HARD CONTENT RULE: The Chinese text below is the implementation prompt BODY and is the ONLY Chinese allowed anywhere in the image. All titles, labels, subheads, source and branding outside this body must use only the exact English strings specified in the art direction. Do not invent Chinese titles, explanatory captions or decorative words.
Render every body paragraph verbatim, in this exact order, with ALL numbers, punctuation, Chinese characters and code tokens accurate. Use line wraps but never rewrite, truncate, repeat or omit content. Chinese body must be clean humanist sans-serif, noncondensed, comfortable to read on a phone, never tiny. Let body occupy the majority of available vertical space. Use precise paragraph spacing and generous but sensible margins. No decorative shapes around text.

variants.label: Apple-inspired
variants.direction: ART DIRECTION 02 — Apple-inspired understated product editorial, not an Apple advertisement.
